environment.firmware: QEMU EDK2 x86_64, Secure Boot not enabled

boot_cdrom.scope: Unmodified ISO boot and real manager keyboard input; no guest diagnostic hooks, network, physical USB or session workload.

boot_usb.scope: Unmodified ISO boot and real manager keyboard input; no guest diagnostic hooks, network, physical USB or session workload.

checks: Unmodified ISO reaches the real manager through UEFI from both optical and USB mass-storage media.
Enter does not create a supposedly persistent archive in the RAM overlay.
Q clears the console and the supervised manager returns after lock and exit.
ACPI poweroff completes and the unrelated synthetic disk remains byte-identical in both boots.
source_verification: All packaged ISO recipe and host source hashes match the current worktree. The client and gateway have separate source/binary manifests.
resolved_boot_failures: Create the minimal /etc/network directory expected by live-boot.
Use nonetworking ip=off: ip=frommedia also activated initramfs-tools network configuration and waited for a NIC.
Bind and allow only /dev/tty1 inside the manager private device namespace; without it systemd failed with 208/STDIN and 209/STDOUT.
limits: Development boot image, not a functional privacy beta.
No USB provisioning or persistent archive creation; /persist is read-only and the manager exposes the limitation.
Network configuration, real provider chat, production KVM sessions and physical hardware are not tested by these boots.
Secure Boot and a verified boot chain are not implemented; checksum files are not signatures.
The unrelated test disk is a synthetic unformatted file; this is not an exhaustive physical-disk leak audit.
